samples.question: Ignore pale gray dots. The amber patch is solid and part of the teal sheet. If only the amber patch were erased to white, would both of these happen: the remaining teal sheet splits into more pieces, and at least one enclosed white pocket opens to the outside? White and solid areas connect through shared edges, not diagonal corners. Answer yes or no.
